load_fx_graph_cache: load a compiled FX graph from the cache or compile and cache it if not found
load_cpp_code_cache: load a compiled C++ shared library from the code cache by source code
load_py_code_cache: load a Python module from the code cache by source code
load_triton_code_cache: load a Triton kernel module from the code cache by kernel name and source code
load_cuda_code_cache: load a compiled CUDA shared library from the code cache
compile_fx_graph_hash: generate a unique cache hash for an FX graph based on graph module, inputs, and kwargs
get_cpp_compiler: get the path to the C++ compiler used by TorchInductor for code compilation
pick_vec_isa: determine the best vector ISA (AVX512, AVX2, etc.) for CPU code generation
async_compile_triton: submit a Triton kernel compilation task to the async compile pool
async_compile_cpp: submit a C++ code compilation task to the async compile pool
